prompt: Revise this architectural six-view sheet while keeping the SAME asset design, materials, six-panel layout, title, captions and provisional footer. The current LEFT and RIGHT images are three-quarter perspective pictures; they need to become REAL SIDE ELEVATIONS. Redraw the FIRST FIVE panels as clean flat orthographic architectural illustrations: FRONT is a single front facade plane with parallel edges, BACK is the opposite single facade plane, LEFT and RIGHT are the two SHORT ENDS viewed exactly 90 degrees to the front, with no glimpse of the long facade. No two adjoining wall faces may be visible in an elevation. Use straight horizontal/vertical edges, remove perspective convergence, sky, garden, ground-photo depth and high camera tilt. Keep just a simple ground line and a minimal scale person if useful. TOP must be exactly overhead, showing roofs, annex footprints and court/entrance alignment with NO VERTICAL FACADE FACES. Only the SIXTH AXONOMETRIC panel may show 3D perspective/isometric form. Keep the asset's existing roof ridge count, storey counts, annex position, entrance location and overall outline consistent between all panels; do not invent a different building. If a wing blocks a facade in the true elevation, show the correct occlusion rather than rotating the view to reveal it. Render matte materials and fine technical edge linework on a warm off-white background. Don't add dimensions or measured claims. This is still a provisional unmeasured concept.
